milestone: LRC-2 | Execution / Presentation / Safety Profile Foundation

evidence.title: Runtime Policy has a versioned NGVGE-owned schema
evidence.detail: ngvge.runtime-policy-set@1 is registered as the versioned Runtime Policy contract.

evidence.title: Execution / Presentation / Safety / Compatibility are separate domains
evidence.detail: Execution, Presentation, Runtime Safety and Scratch Compatibility are represented as independent policy objects.

evidence.title: Simulation tick and presentation refresh are independent
evidence.detail: The high-refresh profile retains a 30 Hz simulation tick while using display-refresh presentation; Scratch interpolation remains domain-scoped.

evidence.title: Each Runtime Policy domain has exactly one Writer Authority
evidence.detail: All six Runtime Policy domains have one unique Writer registration in the Authority Registry.

evidence.title: Scratch backend consumes Runtime Policy through the Compatibility Adapter
evidence.detail: Scratch backend application is exercised through ngvge.scratch-runtime-policy-adapter@1.

evidence.title: Legacy Advanced Settings has no direct Runtime Policy VM/Renderer writer
evidence.detail: Advanced Settings routes Runtime Policy-owned controls through the bridge and Engine Protocol command path; Editor cannot supply Writer Authority identity.

evidence.title: OpsPerFrame is not a Native Runtime Policy field
evidence.detail: opsPerFrame is rejected by Runtime Policy validation and remains explicit Legacy scheduler quarantine.

evidence.title: miscLimits is not a Native Runtime Policy field
evidence.detail: miscLimits is rejected by Runtime Policy validation; explicit compatibility fields are projected to the legacy backend switch only inside the Scratch adapter.

evidence.title: Stage geometry is outside Runtime Policy
evidence.detail: stageWidth and stageHeight are rejected by Runtime Policy validation and remain quarantined for Project/Scene geometry ownership.

evidence.title: Compiler/backend override remains runtime-only
evidence.detail: executionBackend and backendHints are runtime-only Schema properties and are stripped from project Runtime Policy persistence.

evidence.title: Runtime Policy DTOs exclude Scratch/backend-private handles
evidence.detail: VM, renderer, Scratch Target, private backend handles and _twconfig_ identity are rejected from Runtime Policy DTOs.

evidence.title: Cumulative LRC-2 certification and freeze gates are executable
evidence.detail: package.json exposes cumulative lrc2-certification and real-WebPack lrc2-freeze entrypoints.

explicitDeferrals: Green Flag / shortcut FPS ingress -> LRC-3
remaining legacy direct VM caller precedence -> LRC-3
Warp Timer final Runtime Safety ownership
